All previously unread cells are now read. Three defects, not one. 551 cells are the whole REPO Tripartito block (columns 15-20), a thinly traded instrument that clears the published header test but not a 5% density floor: it traded on 95 of 3,653 days. 54 are genuine continuation rows, where a day with several operations is published as one dated aggregate followed by the individual operations; those are emitted as events with the trade date inherited and a positional operation sequence, because the publisher does not number them. The remaining 514 are three published blocks the column-recovery window could not reach because it ran only between the first and last confident data column: the Call Money Market (PYG) block in columns 3-8, which lies before the first, and the Call Money Market (USD) Plazo in column 26 and the Facilidad de Crédito Especial block in columns 28-30, which lie after the last. All are named on row 18 and detailed on row 19. No economic review of definitions, units, period conventions or hierarchy has been done.
